description: Reports where a mastering, cleanup or preview job stands: status, percent progress and final metrics (after_lufs, true_peak_db, lra, platform_ready). Preview jobs list every style with its loudness and a listen link. A finished master also gets download_url, a signed link valid for about an hour with no credentials needed. No cost.

job_id.description: Identifier from master_track, clean_ai_trace or preview_styles; batch_master returns one per entry in job_ids. Letters, digits, underscore and hyphen only, 1 to 64 characters. Not a URL or a file name.

title: Poll a job: progress and metrics
